name: save-boot-12a-dialog-world-entry
description: #108 attempt 1 (diagnostic): load disc1-wm1-kalm as save-boot-7-world-kalm does (Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState 3), then nothing: reports g_WindowData[0].state (win0), pointerEnabled and window 1's state on the first frame of world mode, to tell whether the window #140 found opens before or after world mode starts.

win0.description: g_WindowData[0] (0x80083274, config/symbols.main.us.txt; WindowData 0x30 bytes, include/game.h) .state at +0x2C (s16 as u16): 0 WSTATE_INIT (no window), 1 SHOW, 2 TXT (typing), 4 WAIT_ROW, 6 TXT_DONE (text shown, waits for Circle), 7 CLOSING, 9 INIT_NEXT, 13 PAUSE_TXT_UNTIL_OK, 14 WAIT_NEXT_WINDOW. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@d4db3de3c3aaf61269e048cf3f6a458996290de0 (reference only, no code) include/game.h WindowState, src/field/field_dialog.c.

ptr_en.description: g_WindowData[0] (0x80083274, config/symbols.main.us.txt; WindowData 0x30 bytes, include/game.h) .pointerEnabled at +0x1A: set to 1 in TXT_DONE by FieldDialogAskUpdateStates (a choice window), 0 for a plain message. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@d4db3de3c3aaf61269e048cf3f6a458996290de0 (reference only, no code) src/field/field_dialog.c.
